description.value: This profile defines how the Composition resource is used to represent a Dutch Patient Summary.

purpose.value: This Composition resource represents the Netherlands Patient Summary.

definition.value: Language in which the resource is written. Language is expressed by the IETF language tag.
Business version of the document. The exact algorithm for versioning is decided by the producer/custodian.
Unique identifier of the document.
Status of the document.
Type of document at hand, in this case always 60591-5 Patient summary document.
Additional details about where the content was created (e.g. clinical specialty).
Patient/subject information.
Date of finalizing/issuing the document.
Author(s) of the document.

Human readable document title that can be displayed in search results, etc. This can be documentType's display name, or it can be assembled from multiple elements. Examples: 'Patient Summary of Jane Green 10.12.2024'.
Date and time when the document was authorised.
The person or organisation taking responsibility for the content of the document.
Date and time of the approval of the document by Attester.
Attester who validated the document.
Organisation that is in charge of maintaining the document/report.

Categorisation of the event covered by the document (e.g. laboratory study types, imaging study types including modality, etc.). Selection of such tags or labels depends on the use case and agreement between data sharing parties. This meta-data element serves primarily for searching and filtering purposes.
Time period of information covered in the document.

The label for this particular section. This will be part of the rendered content for the document, and is often used to build a table of contents.

Narrative, potentially formatted, content of the whole section. Must be automatically generated only; manually written narratives are not allowed. Use the healthcare provider's free-text note for that purpose.
